providers.title: AI providers
providers.description: Add a key, sign in with ChatGPT or use a local model. Keys stay in this browser and are only sent to reach the provider.
providers.modelsSuggested: Suggested models. Load the full list from {{name}}.
providers.contextHint: How much source text is sent with each request, in characters. Lower it if your local model has a small context window.
providers.localHint: Local models work when better-vault runs on the same machine.

opencodePlanHint.zen: Zen: pay as you go with credits in your OpenCode console.
opencodePlanHint.go: Go: a monthly OpenCode plan with open coding models. Use the key from your Go subscription.

providers.audioOnly: {{name}} only makes speech. Audio Overviews in Studio use it to read the conversation aloud; it can't chat or write.
providers.opencodeCheck: Check for OpenCode on this computer
providers.opencodeFoundBody: better-vault uses OpenCode's models with your Zen or Go key below.
providers.opencodeMissingBody: better-vault couldn't find OpenCode on this computer. Install it, then check again. A Zen or Go key works without it.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.accentHint: Used for buttons, selections and highlights.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the interface. Answers follow the language you write in, and each Studio tool lets you pick its output language.

data.title: Data
data.description: Everything is stored in this browser.
data.exportHint: Notebooks, sources, chats and outputs as a JSON file. API keys are not included.
data.importHint: Adds the notebooks from a backup file.
data.importFailed: That file is not a better-vault backup.
data.deleteAllHint: Removes every notebook from this browser. Settings and keys are kept.

deleteAllConfirm.title: Delete all notebooks?
deleteAllConfirm.body: Every notebook, source, chat and Studio output in this browser will be deleted. This can't be undone.

data.backupToHint: Saves a backup to its better-vault/backups folder. API keys are not included.
data.restoreFromHint: Adds the notebooks from a backup saved in your storage.

about.title: About & Updates
about.description: An open-source, bring-your-own-model alternative to NotebookLM.

chatgpt.title: Use your ChatGPT plan
chatgpt.description: Chat and Studio use the usage included in your ChatGPT plan, instead of an API key.
chatgpt.inUse: Chat and Studio use your ChatGPT plan. Pictures still need an API key.
chatgpt.noPlanUsage: better-vault isn't allowed to use your ChatGPT plan. Continue with ChatGPT again and allow it.
chatgpt.signedOutUnconfirmed: Signed out here, but ChatGPT didn't confirm it. You can disconnect better-vault in ChatGPT settings.

dialog.title: Continue with ChatGPT
dialog.description: Use your ChatGPT plan in better-vault.
dialog.steps: Your browser opens ChatGPT. Sign in, allow better-vault to use your plan, then come back here.
dialog.waiting: Waiting for you to finish in your browser…
dialog.welcome: Chat and Studio requests in better-vault now use your ChatGPT plan. You can review and limit this usage in ChatGPT settings.

chatgpt.callbackDone: You can close this tab and go back to better-vault.
chatgpt.declined: You didn't allow better-vault to use your ChatGPT plan.
chatgpt.invalidCallback: ChatGPT sent back an answer better-vault couldn't use. Try again.
chatgpt.otherAccount: That's a different ChatGPT account. Choose “Use a different account” to add it.
chatgpt.desktopOnly: Not supported in the web app. Sign in with ChatGPT works in the better-vault desktop app, which keeps your ChatGPT sign-in on your computer.

updates.title: Updates
updates.devBuild: Updates are checked in the installed app
updates.ready: Version {{version}} is ready · restart to install
updates.readyBody: better-vault {{version}} has downloaded. Restart the app to finish installing it; it opens again on its own.
updates.updatedBody: You're now on the newest version. Read the
updates.label: Software update

account.title: Account
account.description: How better-vault knows you on this device. Nothing here leaves it.
account.pictureTooLarge: That picture is larger than 15 MB.
account.pictureFailed: That picture could not be read.
account.name: Name
account.nameHint: Shown in Settings. You can change it any time.
account.space: {{size}} used by better-vault in this browser.

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: Add sources from your cloud files, and keep backups and Studio exports there.

services.google-drive: Pick files from your Drive as sources, and save backups and exports to a better-vault folder.
services.onedrive: Browse your OneDrive for sources, and save backups and exports to a better-vault folder.
services.s3: Use an S3 bucket, or any S3-compatible service, for sources, backups and exports.
services.r2: Use a Cloudflare R2 bucket for sources, backups and exports.

hints.endpoint: For S3-compatible services other than AWS, such as MinIO or Wasabi.
hints.prefix: better-vault keeps to this folder; leave empty for the whole bucket.

storage.keysPrivacy: Keys stay on this device and are sent only with the requests that use the bucket.
storage.notSetUp: This copy of better-vault isn't set up to sign in to this service yet.
storage.driveAccess: better-vault sees only the files you pick and the ones it makes.
storage.driveDesktop: better-vault asks only for the files you pick and the ones it makes. In the desktop app you can save backups and exports, and add files better-vault has opened before; picking new files needs the web app.
storage.onedriveAccess: better-vault reads the files you choose and writes only to its better-vault folder.

browser.none: No storage connected. Connect one in Settings → Storage.
browser.pickerHint: Choose files in Google's own picker. better-vault can open only the files you pick.
browser.empty: No files here that can be added.
browser.skipped_one: Not added, because better-vault can't read this kind of file: {{names}}
browser.skipped_other: Not added, because better-vault can't read these kinds of files: {{names}}

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Choose how your calendar looks and follow calendars by their .ics address. Entries stay on this device.

google.label: Google Calendar
google.hint: Show and edit your Google calendars

subscribe.label: Subscribe to a calendar
subscribe.hint: Add an .ics link, such as a class timetable

export.label: Import and export
export.hint: Move entries in and out as .ics files

defaultView.label: Default view
defaultView.hint: What the calendar shows when it opens

weekNumbers.label: Week numbers
weekNumbers.hint: Show the week of the year beside the day and week views

workingHours.label: Working hours
workingHours.hint: Tint the hours you work on the grid

subscribe.title: Subscribe to a calendar
subscribe.description: Paste the .ics or webcal:// address of a calendar, such as a class timetable or public holidays. It is fetched again every few hours.
subscribe.found_one: Found {{count}} entry. Give the calendar a name and a colour.
subscribe.found_other: Found {{count}} entries. Give the calendar a name and a colour.
subscribe.name: Title

studio.title: Studio
studio.description: Choose which tools the Studio offers. A tool you turn off leaves the Studio sheet; what it already made stays in your notebooks.
studio.lastOne: At least one tool stays on
studio.visualsHint: Chat answers may show diagrams, tables, charts and flashcards when they explain better than text.

mcp.title: MCP
mcp.description: Let AI agents on this computer, such as Claude Code, Cursor and Codex, read your notebooks and notes and share skills with you, through the Model Context Protocol.
mcp.desktopOnlyBody: Agents connect to a server on your own computer, which a browser tab can't run. The desktop app runs it, and your data stays on your device.

status.running: Listening on {{url}}, for this computer only

mcp.readOnlyHint: Agents can read but never change anything
mcp.allowNotesHint: Create notes and replace their text
mcp.regenerate: New token (agents must be set up again)

hints.claude-code: Run this in a terminal. Claude Code then lists better-vault's tools in /mcp.
hints.cursor: Add this to .cursor/mcp.json in a project, or to your global Cursor settings.
hints.claude-desktop: Add this to claude_desktop_config.json; mcp-remote bridges Claude Desktop to the local server.

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.description: Better Vault AI runs Claude Haiku for you, and Better Vault Cloud keeps your backups. Both are optional: the app stays free with your own keys.

includes.pro: 1,250 AI credits a month and 20 GB of cloud storage
includes.max: 3,500 AI credits a month and 50 GB of cloud storage

subscription.popupBlocked: Allow pop-ups for this page to sign in.
subscription.keysStay: Your own API keys stay on this device and are never sent to Better Vault.
subscription.noPlanHint: Choose a plan to use Better Vault AI and Cloud.
subscription.overageHint: Keep using AI after your credits run out, at $2 per 1,000 credits, up to a limit you choose.
subscription.manageHint: Change plan, see invoices or cancel in Polar's customer portal.

welcome.title: Welcome to {{plan}}
welcome.credits_one: {{count}} AI credit every month with Better Vault AI
welcome.credits_other: {{count}} AI credits every month with Better Vault AI
welcome.storage: {{size}} GB of Better Vault Cloud for backups
welcome.keys: Your own API keys keep working and stay on this device
